title: French Red Wine Chicken with Mushrooms and Bacon
summary: A rustic French-style braise of chicken, bacon, mushrooms and onions simmered in red wine until rich and glossy. It’s hearty, savoury and ideal for a comforting dinner.
steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season them lightly with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large deep pan over medium-high heat. Brown the bacon for 3 to 4 minutes, then remove it to a plate.
In the same pan, brown the chicken on both sides until well coloured, about 4 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
Add the onion to the pan and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, then pour in the red wine and water, scraping up any browned bits from the pan.
Add the thyme, bay leaves, bacon and chicken. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook on low heat for 35 to 40 minutes until the chicken is tender and cooked through.
Uncover and simmer for another 5 to 10 minutes to reduce the sauce until glossy and lightly thickened. Taste and adjust with salt and pepper.
Discard the bay leaves, scatter over the parsley, and serve hot with potatoes, rice or crusty bread if desired.
